title: Harden ticket-sync as Spec Kit task to Beads backlog bridge
description:
Objective: agentic-development-foundation
Spec: 001-workflow-foundation
Task: T033
Acceptance: uv run awf workflow-fixture-test

Make uv run awf ticket-sync --write the idempotent bridge from approved open Spec Kit tasks into Beads. It should avoid duplicate tickets, preserve spec id/objective id/task id/source path/acceptance command, skip completed tasks, and leave implementers querying uv run awf ready-work as the primary executable backlog.
close_reason: Implemented and approved on 2026-05-10. Acceptance checks passed and T033 marked complete.
